subject: StataStan interface (alpha test) is on Github

messages.author: 83aa4ea66d984b54
messages.subject: StataStan interface (alpha test) is on Github
parts:
StataStan, the interface that lets you call Stan from inside Stata, is now on Github here: https://github.com/stan-dev/statastan/tree/alpha-test

If you have a copy of Stata, I would welcome your feedback on using it, especially on versions and flavors - and operating systems - not yet tested out.

There are (at least) two neat ways of including your Stan model inline in your do-file, and I will be adding these to the stan-example.do file very soon.
